ACME INSURANCE COMPANY
CLAIM DEPARTMENT - COVERAGE DETERMINATION

Claim No.: 2026-CLM-055810
Policy No.: AUTO-19-22014-B
Date of Loss: February 2, 2026
Date Filed: February 5, 2026

INSURED: Riley Chen
INSURER: Acme Insurance Company
ADJUSTER: M. Okonkwo, Auto Claims
CLAIM TYPE: Auto - collision damage to insured vehicle

DESCRIPTION OF LOSS:
The insured's 2019 Honda Civic struck a parking barrier in a private garage
in Madison, Wisconsin. Front bumper and headlamp assembly were damaged.

CLAIMED AMOUNT: $4,280.00

COVERAGE DETERMINATION: DENIED.

DENIAL REASONS:
- Policy exclusion: collision coverage lapsed for non-payment effective
  January 15, 2026; the loss occurred after the lapse.
- Wear-and-tear / maintenance exclusion does not apply; the controlling
  reason is the coverage lapse.

SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS: police incident note (none); photos of bumper damage;
declarations page showing lapse; cancellation notice dated January 10, 2026.
